arguments.yaml:
appId: com.pbordjadze.paintbynumber
---
- tapOn:
    id: change-painting
- extendedWaitUntil:
    visible:
      id: refine-done
    timeout: 120000
- tapOn:
    id: refine-tool-pen
- swipe:
    start: '70%,36%'
    end: '92%,40%'
    duration: 1200
- takeScreenshot: /Users/runner/work/paint-by-number/paint-by-number/out/shots/d11-wave-pen
- tapOn:
    id: refine-done
    waitToSettleTimeoutMs: 100
- pressKey: Home
- stopApp
- launchApp
- waitForAnimationToEnd:
    timeout: 15000
